description: Source code for a switch configuration utility, including functions for listing switch attributes, showing port and VLAN info, loading configurations, and command-line interface handling.

methods.name: print_attrs
methods.description: Prints attributes of a switch attribute list.

methods.name: list_attributes
methods.description: Displays detailed attributes of a switch device.

methods.name: speed_str
methods.description: Converts a speed integer to a string representation.

methods.name: free_attr_val
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for attribute values based on attribute type.

methods.name: print_attr_val
methods.description: Prints the value of a switch attribute.

methods.name: show_attrs
methods.description: Displays attributes for a specific switch device and attribute list.

methods.name: show_port
methods.description: Displays attributes for a specific port.

methods.name: show_vlan
methods.description: Displays attributes for a specific VLAN.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the CLI.

methods.name: swconfig_load_uci
methods.description: Loads switch configuration from a UCI file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the switch configuration CLI, handling command parsing and execution.
